notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Hello. Thanks to everyone who purchased the Heralds of Silence and especially to those who left feedback. I prepared first update and it include:

1)  Fix bug when key from loading area dissapear after examine.
2) Make some sound effects lower
3) Added a hint about what can be done quieter or turn off the noise
4) Added a hint about what you can try to avoid monster by pressing back button

Hope you like this changes. Please leave feedback and I will try make better games
